key_points: Amazon announced a multi-year AI chip partnership with Qualcomm, opening a new data‑center revenue stream
Analyst StoneX reiterated a Buy rating with a $270 price target, citing leverage in the data‑center segment
QCOM shares have surged ~40% YTD on accelerating data‑center orders and momentum from the deal
Valuation remains modestly premium (≈6‑7% over GF value) but dividend sustainability is highlighted
Growth outlook now hinges on execution of AI/automotive initiatives beyond the smartphone business
